title: Dealt.
old_caption: One star says yes instantly. The other hides in a shell, heart thumping. Both are allowed. Being nervous doesn't mean you're not interested. It often means you are.

title: Face Last.
old_caption: Your perfect Sunday is a long run. Theirs is a blanket fort. Different doesn't have to mean wrong for each other. Getting curious about their world is the real move.

title: The Comet Returns.
old_caption:
Orbit, Ep 3: an ex sweeps in with glitter and a wind machine, and Tide disappears into her shell. Ember tries knocking, then tries something gentler.
Ask before you assume. Feelings can't be heard through a shell.

title: We Need to Talk.
old_caption: "We need to talk" can send anyone spiralling. Sometimes it leads to "I like you a lot, and that scares me." The scary true thing is often the kindest one to say.

title: The Constellation.
old_caption: Meeting a loud group of friends when you're the quiet one can feel overwhelming. A good partner notices, lowers the volume, and makes room for you in their world.

title: Same Sky.
old_caption:
Orbit finale: Ember gets a chance to shine far away, and Tide steps out of her shell to say "go." The goodbye is tender, the nightly talks are sweeter.
Love isn't holding on tight. It's cheering them on.

title: The Bowling Date.
old_caption:
Gutter balls, a mid-lane collision, and the booth is ready to call it. Then the replay shows them both laughing.
The awkward moments are often the part you'll love remembering.

title: The Cooking Date.
old_caption: Boiled-over pot, sauce on the ceiling, crunchy noodles. The plan flopped. They ordered in and danced in the kitchen anyway. A messy night can still be a perfect date.

title: The Mini-Golf Date.
old_caption: One of them kept score, the other smelled the flowers. The best play of the night was the putt missed on purpose just to hear them laugh. Win the date, not the game.

title: Capricorn Season.
old_caption: Tonight's forecast: cozy, steady and serious, with reading glasses that refuse to come off. Every Friday is already circled through next month. Happy Capricorn season. Who's your Friday?
